info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Event Test Subscriptions-spec
info.description: The Event Test Subscription Management API facilitates the retrieval of test event subscriptions for specific webhooks and events. By querying this endpoint, users can obtain detailed information about the test subscriptions associated with a particular webhook and event combination. This API serves developers and system integrators who need to verify webhook configurations and ensure proper event handling. It supports scenarios where testing and validation of notification protocols are essential for system reliability and performance. The API provides structured data to inform necessary adjustments or confirmations during the testing phase.

get.summary: Retrieve test subscriptions for a specific webhook.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the list of test subscriptions associated with a specified webhook. It facilitates the verification and testing of webhook configurations, ensuring that events are sent correctly.
